prompt: Create a PORTRAIT 2:3 portfolio cover for HEX MYTHICA, end-to-end development of a roguelite deck-building game including gameplay, backend, multiplayer and infrastructure through WhoCaresGames. Use attached image as EXACT art-direction reference for a coherent five-cover series: premium editorial photographic collage, precise overlapping photographic cutouts, warm monochrome stone and charcoal photography, selective deep petrol teal duotone planes, subtle analogue grain, one thin amber routing line. NOT fantasy game key art, NOT cartoon, NOT paper sculpture. No text, logos, letters, numbers, watermarks. Invent an evocative still-life photographic montage: three large richly detailed dark playing cards fanned in the middle, each with a distinct invented etched fantasy illustration (ancient archway, branching magical tree, crystalline mountain), restrained amber details, no text and no suits copied from a game. Behind them a sharply photographed craggy rock arch / ruined stone doorway and a landscape fragment form the game world. A subtle hexagonal board fragment below the cards, and one amber route branching into paired small linked playing-card silhouettes suggest gameplay and multiplayer. Let the cards and imagined world be the unmistakable hero; computing infrastructure stays conceptual and subordinate, no generic monitor required. Physical photographic materials and sophisticated print collage, not a miniature diorama. Keep main cluster inside central 80% width and central 60% height, generous headroom for wide tile crops. Bottom 18% quiet dark teal title area. Full-bleed deep teal ground. Shared series grammar: tall photographic fragment upper-left, work artifacts cross the middle, amber connection, teal breathing room. Explicitly conceptual original imagery, not actual Hex Mythica cards, screenshots, approved game art, or evidence of a released game.
